stories.event: On the eve of the 3 November midterm elections the Republican National Committee advised that Donald Trump and JD Vance would hold a final rally in Rome, New York, on Monday 2 November; other reporting bills it as Vance's last rally, and Trump has been cancelling and reinstating appearances in favour of tele-rallies.
